name: daily-nonogram
description: A daily Nonogram (picture-logic) puzzle web app — a new solvable picture every day.

scripts.start: node -e "require('http').createServer((rq,rs)=>{const f=require('fs'),p=require('path');let u=rq.url.split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const fp=p.join(process.cwd(),decodeURIComponent(u));f.readFile(fp,(e,d)=>{if(e){rs.statusCode=404;return rs.end('not found')}const t={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript'}[p.extname(fp)]||'application/octet-stream';rs.setHeader('content-type',t);rs.end(d)})}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('Daily Nonogram → http://localhost:8080'))"
